error.sobreestimo: Look at the whole group at once.

error.mismo_aspecto_global: They all look almost the same.
One of them has a different shape — look at the sides and corners.

error.conto_desde_uno: The line already tells you where you are.

error.p.resto_en_vez_de_sumar: You took away instead of adding.
Both numbers join together — try adding them.
error.p.sumo_en_vez_de_restar: You added instead of taking away.
Start from the bigger number and take the other one away.
error.p.no_llevo: The new ten did not get carried over.
When the ones pass ten, carry one ten to the next column.
error.p.llevo_de_mas: A ten got carried over that was not needed.
Check the ones column — does it really pass ten?
error.p.no_pidio: The tens column was not adjusted after borrowing.
When you borrow, the tens column has one ten fewer.
error.p.pidio_sin_faltar: A ten got borrowed that was not needed.
Look at the ones column first — is the top digit big enough?
error.p.resto_menor_del_mayor: Each column took the smaller digit from the bigger one.
Subtract downwards: borrow a ten when the top digit is smaller.
error.p.olvido_el_cero: The zero at the end went missing.
That answer ends in zero — keep it in its place.
error.p.alineo_mal: The one-digit number was lined up with the tens.
Line up the ones with the ones, on the right.
error.p.comparo_desde_las_unidades: That one has the biggest last digit.
Compare from the left: thousands first, then hundreds.
error.p.comparo_solo_una_posicion: That one only wins in one position.
Compare every position, starting from the left.
error.p.dijo_la_cifra: That is the digit itself, not its value.
What is that place worth — ones, tens, hundreds or thousands?
error.p.corrio_un_lugar: That is the value one place too far left.
Count the places from the right to find where the digit sits.
error.p.cayo_un_lugar: That is the value one place too far right.
Count the places from the right to find where the digit sits.
error.p.se_quedo_en_el_paso: That is only the first part of the work.
One step is still missing — finish it.
error.p.sumo_las_cifras: All four digits got added together.
Add tens with tens and ones with ones, not digit by digit.
error.p.sumo_el_final: The last part got added back instead of taken away.
Keep taking away — the second step also subtracts.
error.p.paso_disparejo: The step changed size at the end.
Measure the step between two neighbours — it stays the same.
error.p.sumo_dos_pasos: That jumps two steps at once.
Add the step just once to the last number.
error.p.repitio_el_ultimo_numero: That is the last number shown, not the next one.
Work out the step between two neighbours and apply it once more.
error.p.siguio_sumando: This pattern does not add — it doubles.
Check: each number is the one before times two.
error.p.repitio_la_diferencia: The gap between numbers grows each time.
Look at how the gaps change — each one is two more.

error.a.pct_coma_corrida: Divided by ten instead of a hundred: the result came out ten times too big.
The % sign means «per hundred»: divide by a hundred, not by ten.
error.a.pct_dividio_de_mas: Divided one time too many: the result came out ten times too small.
One step only: divide by a hundred (or multiply by the percentage and move the point two places).
error.a.pct_resto_puntos: The percentage points were subtracted as if they were plain units.
First work out how much that percentage of the amount is, then subtract it.
error.a.pct_sumo_puntos: The percentage points were added as if they were plain units.
First work out how much that percentage of the amount is, then add it.
error.a.pct_solo_el_porcentaje: That is only the part (the discount or the tip), not the total.
One step left: subtract that part from the original amount, or add it.
error.a.pct_sumo_en_vez_de_quitar: The discount was added, and a discount comes off.
The final price is the original price minus the discount.
error.a.pct_quito_en_vez_de_sumar: The percentage was subtracted, and here it goes on top.
Tip, tax or raise: the total is the amount plus the percentage.
error.a.frac_sin_numerador: Divided by the denominator and stopped there: multiplying by the numerator is missing.
Two steps: divide by the denominator, then multiply by the numerator.
error.a.frac_complemento: That is the part that is left over, not the part that was asked for.
The fraction names the part you want: compute that one, not its complement.
error.a.frac_invertida: The fraction was applied upside down: numerator and denominator swapped.
Divide by the denominator and multiply by the numerator, in that order.
error.a.frac_sin_dividir: Multiplied by the numerator without dividing by the denominator first.
Fraction of an amount: divide by the denominator first, multiply after.
error.a.frac_pegada: The two digits were written side by side with a decimal point.
A fraction is a division: numerator divided by denominator.
error.a.frac_reves_decimal: The division was done upside down: denominator divided by numerator.
The fraction bar reads «divided by»: the top number is divided by the bottom one.
error.a.dec_coma_corrida: The decimal point ended up one place off.
Check the order of magnitude: is the result ten times more or less than reasonable?
error.a.prop_aditivo: The difference was added, and proportionality is multiplicative.
Double the time, double the parts: multiply by the same factor instead of adding the difference.
error.a.prop_sin_dividir: Multiplied without working out the rate: the division is missing.
First parts per hour (divide), then that value times the hours (multiply).
error.a.prop_invertida: The ratio was applied upside down.
Order: first the rate (parts per hour), then multiply it by the hours asked for.
error.a.prop_solo_la_tasa: That is the rate for ONE hour: it still needs scaling to the hours asked.
The rate is the middle step — multiply it by the hours the problem asks about.
error.a.pot_duplico: The number was doubled, and squaring is not doubling.
A square is the number times itself: the same factor twice.
error.a.pot_vecino_cuadrado: That is the square of the neighbouring number.
Check: your answer divided by the number must give the number itself.
error.a.pot_por_el_siguiente: Multiplied by the next number, not by itself.
Squaring is the number times ITSELF, not times the one after.
error.a.raiz_mitad: Divided by two, and a square root is not a half.
Look for the number that multiplied by itself gives the value inside.
error.a.raiz_vecino: One off the exact value: the result was not checked by squaring.
Square your answer — it must give exactly the number inside.
error.a.raiz_cifras_invertidas: Check by squaring: your answer times itself must give the number inside.
error.a.orden_izquierda: Worked left to right, and multiplication takes priority.
Multiplications and divisions first; additions and subtractions after.
error.a.orden_par_mal: The multiplication was applied to the wrong pair.
Multiplication joins the two numbers it touches — the addition waits.
error.a.orden_sumo_todo: Everything was added, including what should be multiplied.
There is a multiplication in the middle: solve it first, then add.
error.a.orden_ignoro_parentesis: The parentheses were ignored, and parentheses rule.
Whatever is inside the parentheses is always solved first.
error.a.signo_ignoro: Adding a negative is subtracting: the result takes the sign of the larger absolute value.
error.a.signo_todo_negativo: Everything came out negative, and only one of the numbers is.
The sign of the result is decided by the operation and the larger absolute value, not by «there was a minus around».
error.a.signo_al_reves: The value is right but the sign came out backwards.
The result takes the sign of the number with the larger absolute value.
error.a.signo_menos_por_mas: Minus times plus gave plus: the sign got lost.
A single negative factor is enough to make the product negative.
error.a.signo_sumo: The values were added instead of multiplied.
The operation is a product: multiply the values first, then decide the sign.
error.a.signo_resto: The values were subtracted instead of multiplied.
It is a multiplication: the product of the values first, then the sign.
error.a.signo_resta_doble: The negative was subtracted as if it were positive.
Subtracting a negative IS adding: two minus signs in a row become a plus.
error.a.ecu_resto: The coefficient was subtracted instead of divided by.
The coefficient multiplies x: undo it by dividing both sides by it.
error.a.ecu_sumo: The coefficient was added instead of divided by.
The coefficient multiplies x: undo it by dividing both sides by it.
error.a.ecu_multiplico: Multiplied by the coefficient instead of dividing by it.
To undo a multiplication use the inverse operation: divide both sides by the coefficient.
error.a.ecu_no_dividio: The last step is missing: dividing by the coefficient.
After moving the loose term, divide both sides by the number next to x.
error.a.ecu_sumo_en_vez_de_restar: The term that adds was moved by adding.
A term that adds moves to the other side subtracting.
error.a.ecu_resto_en_vez_de_sumar: The term that subtracts was moved by subtracting.
A term that subtracts moves to the other side adding.
error.a.ecu_orden_inverso: The inverse operations were applied in reverse order.
Remove the loose term first (add or subtract), and only then divide by the coefficient.
error.a.media_sin_dividir: That is the sum of the four values, without dividing.
The mean is the sum divided by how many values there are.
error.a.media_mediana: That is the median, not the mean.
The mean is the sum of all of them divided by how many there are; the median is the one in the middle.
error.a.media_pareo: The sum was divided by two, not by the number of values.
The mean divides the sum by HOW MANY values there are — here there are four.
error.a.media_repito: Repeating the mean does not add up: the known ones do not average that.
The missing one has to compensate: rebuild the total and subtract what is known.
error.a.media_no_resto: That is the total of ALL of them: the known ones still need removing.
From the total (mean times count) subtract the sum of the ones you already know.
error.a.media_de_las_conocidas: That is the mean of the known ones, not the missing one.
Rebuild the total (mean times count), subtract what is known, and what is left is the answer.
error.a.est_orden_menor: The order of magnitude came out ten times too low.
Check how many digits the result should have before choosing.
error.a.est_orden_mayor: The order of magnitude came out ten times too high.
Check how many digits the result should have before choosing.
error.a.est_a_la_baja: Round each factor to its NEAREST ten — one usually goes up and the other down.
error.a.est_mitad: Only one of the two numbers was rounded.
To estimate, round both: the percentage to the nearest ten and the amount to the nearest hundred.
error.a.mcd_confundio_mcm: That is the least common MULTIPLE, not the greatest common divisor.
The greatest common divisor cannot be larger than the smaller of the two numbers.
error.a.mcd_no_maximo: It is a common divisor, but not the greatest one.
List the common divisors and keep the largest.
error.a.mcm_confundio_mcd: That is the greatest common DIVISOR, not the least common multiple.
The least common multiple cannot be smaller than the larger of the two numbers.
error.a.mcm_producto: Multiplying the two numbers gives A common multiple, but not the least.
Since they share factors, the least is the product divided by the greatest common divisor.
error.a.mcm_suma: Common multiples are not found by adding the numbers.
List multiples of the larger one until you hit one the smaller also divides exactly.
error.a.sec_diferencia: The last difference was repeated, and here the difference is not the rule.
Look at how each term is built from the ones before, not just at the distance between neighbours.
error.a.sec_duplico: The last term was doubled, and doubling is not the rule.
Test your rule against ALL the terms shown, not just the last step.
error.a.sec_vecinos: Terms that do not belong together were added.
Look at which previous terms produce the next one, and apply it exactly once.
error.a.div_multiplo_vecino: That is the multiple of the divisor that sits right next to it.
Check by multiplying: divisor times quotient must give the dividend.
error.a.div_cifras: The digits of the quotient came out backwards.
Multiply your answer by the divisor: it must give the exact dividend.
